tldr: Sarah, you have one ad running, and it's a giveaway that's been live for almost two years. Meta has long since stopped showing it to fresh buyers, and you have nothing else selling your actual products.

benchmark.context: Most bath and body brands your size put out a fresh ad every three weeks or so. The best ones do it every two weeks. You have one ad, and it's been running for 683 days, so Meta has basically nothing new to show anyone.

drivers: This ad has been live for 683 days, which is roughly 24 times longer than your ideal window, so Meta shows it to almost no one now.
It's a giveaway, not a product ad, so every dollar spent brings in freebie hunters instead of paying customers.
The link sends people to fb.me, not your store, so even winners never see your soap, lotion, or candle pages.

hero_concept.hook: The hand wash that turns a sink into a spa.
hero_concept.headline: Bergamot. Grapefruit. Rose.
hero_concept.primary_text:
Made in small batches on the Mornington Peninsula, our Luxe Hand Wash pairs bergamot, pink grapefruit, and rose geranium into a scent that lingers on your hands long after you dry them.

The pack comes with one pump and three matching soap bars, so the powder room stays stocked for months. It's the kind of small daily upgrade that turns a chore into a moment.

Free shipping on Australian orders over $75.
hero_concept.visual_direction: The pump bottle and three soap bars arranged on a marble vanity with soft morning light and a linen hand towel.
hero_concept.fills_gap: Right now your one ad is a giveaway, so nothing you're running actually shows a product or a price. This gives Meta a real ad that sells something, sends people to your store, and gives Sarah a starting point to build a small stack of different ads around.

Do NOT add or remove any bottles or bars, do NOT change the item count from four, do NOT unwrap the soap bars, do NOT remove or alter the printed labels or brand text, do NOT swap the pump for a different closure style. Render the product's metal, color, finish, fabric, weave, stones, surface treatment, AND every visible construction detail (silhouette, closures, hardware count, pockets, sleeves, neckline, printed graphics) EXACTLY as they appear in the reference image.
